page.layout: One printed page, one text column at full width. Running head at top right, page number at top left. No marginal notes. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: Rejiciatur breviter error ubiquitariorum, de allegorica ascensione & disparitione, quo con-solatio & spes nostra convellitur.
Conclusio: Hæc de causis & fructibus effusi Spiritus sancti in Pentecoste nunc repetenda duxi.

Hortatio ut sedulo meditemur, & grata mente amplectamur tanta beneficia: non tantum reti-neamus fidem veram de Spiritu sancto: propter hæreticos qui passim veteres blasphemias reno-vant: Sed etiam perpetua resipiscentia, modestia, reverentia superiorum, sedulitate, diligentia, & ardentibus votis dona ejus nobis collata conser-vare & augere studeamus: nec ingratitudine ef-fundamus: aut contristemus Spiritum sanctum, quo sumus obsignati. Gratias itaque agimus, &c.
main_text.head: Exercitatio X. De vetere & nova Pentecoste; & de beneficiis Ecclesiæ in utraq; collatis.
main_text.p: EXordium: Oratores in exordiis solere uti purgatione vel captatione benevolentiæ: qua vel ingenio suo, vel causæ, vel auditoribus diffi-dunt. Te neutrum nunc operose facturum non quod confidas ingenio, vel valeas dicendi aliqua vi aut usu: Ab utroque enim te imparatum: Sed.
main_text.l: 2. quia sciant hæc esse exercitia Tyronum, in quibus non solet requiri τ' ἀνεχέσ[?]εις[?], eaque se a-mare frequentia sua jam testentur.

page.notes: The page number reads "400" but the zeros are set in old-style figures and may look like "4oo"; I have given it as 400. The Greek word after "requiri" is small and only partly legible; the reading τ' ἀνεχέσεις is a best guess and is marked [?]. The first word "EXordium" begins with a large initial E joined to small type "Xordium". The final "3.quia" is the catchword at the foot right, copied as printed. The first line is a continuation from the previous page.
